name: Hopper poses: kick-mantle
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Animation production key-pose sheet. The first reference is canonical anatomy; the second illustrates action language only. Air_Kick: body level, massive HIND legs extend backward in a sweep; Wall_Kick: hind feet plant on a small neutral vertical plane; Ledge_Mantle: front feet hook a small neutral ledge, haul body upward. Three side views top and matching three-quarter below. Six legs throughout. Never punch or kick with front legs. Preserve six legs in three bilateral pairs, green armour, blue body accents, red compound eyes, gold antennae, and paired wings. Same boy seated in the red COUCH BEHIND and BELOW handlebars; do not put him on the handlebars. No redesign or detached body parts. 1970s anime production model sheet, confident dark ink contours, readable flat cel colour masses, very restrained gouache brush detail. Uniform warm cream background. Even neutral lighting, no cast shadows, no scenery, no captions, no words, no logos, no panel borders. Full subject in every panel, ample margins, never crop feet, tails or wing tips. Orthographic views must show the SAME character, not variants. Request 3840x1920, wide 2:1. No text. Poses only; no lasers, particle effects or motion blur obscuring anatomy.

contract.name: Hopper: traversal and air-combat clips
contract.summary: New clips on the existing HopperRig. No mesh or joint changes. Walk/Run stay in place; every airborne clip is physics-driven (no root motion). Wings open from the folded rest pose.
contract.clips: Wing_Open (0.25 s), Glide_Loop (wings spread, hind legs trailing), Wing_Close (0.2 s), Dive_Loop (legs tucked, head down), Stomp_Land (deep compression + shockwave pose, 0.6 s), Air_Kick (Spin_Kick timed for 0.6 s with the body level), Wall_Kick (plant + push, 0.35 s), Ledge_Mantle (front legs hook, haul, 0.7 s), Hop_Back (0.45 s), Crouch_Charge_Loop (femurs compressing progressively, 0.8 s, sampled by charge), Super_Leap_Start (0.3 s), Lock_Strafe_L/R (sidestep loops), Hit_Air (0.5 s), Land_Heavy (from a dive, 0.8 s)
